component.name: DJ USB Tkit
component.summary: Local-first DJ library manager and USB exporter for CDJ/XDJ, rekordbox and Engine DJ

ul.li: Library scanning, playlist management, and local playback
USB import and export with mirror and additive playlist sync
Local BPM, key, waveform, and artwork analysis
A cue editor for hot cues, memory cues, beat grid, key, and playback start
Import of tracks, playlists and hot cues from rekordbox and Mixxx
Transcodes to MP3 320, AIFF or WAV, kept on the same track with its cues and playlists
An Engine DJ library on the USB for Denon and Numark players
USB diagnostics and repair tools, with backups made before every USB write
